title: Twist Vase / Pen Pot
description: Six-lobed twisting sculptural pot: a pen cup, dried-flower vase or small-plant cover. The twist is gentle enough to print with no supports.
use: Pencil pot or dried-flower vase. Not watertight for water: use a glass inside for fresh flowers.
material: PLA/PETG, 0.2 mm layers, vase mode not required. Looks great in silk or two-tone filament.
